basic_info.description: Stunning Junior One-Bedroom nestled in the heart of vibrant NOPA, Just one block from the hot Divisadero corridor, you'll have San Francisco's best cafes, restaurants, and boutiques right at your doorstep. Alamo Square is only three blocks away perfect for enjoying the city's iconic scenery. The thoughtfully designed space features a cozy bedroom, an in-unit washer/dryer, a spacious living area, and a full kitchen. Not to be missed are the elegant exposed brick walls. Quietly tucked away at the back of the building, it offers a peaceful retreat while keeping you effortlessly close to everything. An incredible opportunity as the home further benefits from a low monthly HOA of $540 and structural foundation retrofit in 2022! See disclosures for more info. Now is your chance to secure a stunning home in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods.
